name: NLU Benchmark Dataset
description: A large, multi-domain dataset of 25K user utterances annotated with Intent and Entity Type specifications, designed to evaluate and compare popular Natural Language Understanding services for building conversational agents.
reputation: A classic and widely cited NLU benchmark dataset for intent and entity extraction, commonly used to evaluate commercial and academic conversational agents.
notes: First wide coverage evaluation of popular NLU services including Watson, Dialogflow, LUIS, and Rasa on a large multi-domain dataset.
